Sphyrna lewini is a migratory shark of warm coastal and semi-oceanic waters around the world. It is recognizable by its wide, flattened head, and it can grow to about 4 meters.

It matures late and produces few young, and many pups depend on shallow coastal nurseries, which makes the species slow to recover from overfishing.
